what: Plan excludes carryover only in round_tracked_dirty_outside_manifest, but leaves the post-commit tracked residue check unchanged.
scenario_or_breakage: After the first commit, the pre-existing dirty path remains in git status. The follow-up block runs, stage_round_dirty_paths can still produce a non-empty manifest from the old pre-coder head, git-commit.sh has nothing new to commit, and the round returns CODER_STATUS=failed instead of accepting the legitimate coder commit.
suggested_fix: Teach the post-commit residue check to ignore unchanged pre-coder carryover paths, or skip the follow-up path when all remaining tracked dirt is carryover. Add an end-to-end orchestrator regression for pre-existing carryover dirt plus a real coder delta, not only the extracted guard unit test.
